chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAmr, from Abān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: How should I place my hand upon the graves of the Muslims? So he gestured with his hand toward the ground, then placed it upon it while facing the qiblah.

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the ground; the Imam عليه السلام indicated the manner by pointing to the earth
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims; indicating the graves being visited belong to Muslim believers
key_terms.قُبُورِ: graves; the burial places of the deceased Muslims
key_terms.مُقَابِلُ الْقِبْلَةِ: facing the qiblah; oriented toward the direction of prayer
key_terms.يَدِي: my hand; referring to the physical act of placing the hand on the grave

ai.seo_question: How should one place the hand on the graves of Muslims according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of placing one’s hand on the graves of Muslims, as demonstrated by Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام. It indicates a practical etiquette connected to visitation of graves, specifically placing the hand upon the grave while facing the qiblah.
